activities.name: Up or Down?
activities.blurb: Read the candlestick chart, trend, volume and moving averages, then predict the next move and size your bet. Real markets are far less predictable!
activities.entryBlurb: Look at the chart. Will the price go UP or DOWN next?

activities.name: Trading Floor Quiz
activities.blurb: Stocks, bonds, funds, risk and return.

activities.name: Asset or Liability?
activities.blurb: Sort each item: something you own, or something you owe?

activities.name: Portfolio Challenge
activities.blurb: Split $10,000 across cash, bonds, an index fund and hot stocks. Simulate 10 years of markets and inflation. Did your REAL return beat inflation?
activities.entryBlurb: Pick a money basket and see how it grows in 10 years!

activities.name: Dollar-Cost Averaging Lab
activities.blurb: Invest a fixed amount every month through ups and downs, then compare with trying to time the market.

activities.name: Wall Street Quiz Tower
activities.blurb: Climb the tower! Each floor mixes money fun facts with money questions, and they get harder as you go up. Get 2 of 3 to reach the next floor.

activities.name: Breaking News Desk
activities.blurb: Read each headline: which company is affected, and does its stock go up, down, or barely move?
activities.entryBlurb: Good news or bad news for the company?

activities.name: Pitch Night
activities.blurb: Hear 4 startup pitches and invest your own real money. Results arrive in a few Fin City months, most startups fail, a few pay off big.
activities.entryBlurb: Listen to new business ideas and decide which ones to support with play money!

activities.name: Hype or Real?
activities.blurb: Sort investment claims: reasonable, or get-rich-quick hype?

activities.name: Equity Research Desk
activities.blurb: Value four real-world-style companies with a discounted cash flow model, convert enterprise value to a price per share, and make the Buy, Hold or Sell call like a sell-side analyst.

activities.name: Balance Sheet Builder
activities.blurb: Sort a company’s accounts into assets, liabilities and equity, check the sheet balances, then read it with the current ratio and debt-to-equity.

activities.name: Short Seller's Desk
activities.blurb: Pick apart a hyped company: profits that never turn into cash, slow-paying customers, insiders selling. Then work out a short’s profit, its borrow fee and its unlimited risk.

activities.name: Meme Stock Week
activities.blurb: Live through five days of a hype cycle. Read the feed, decide how much to risk and when to get out, then see who ended up holding the bag.

activities.name: Which Company Would You Own?
activities.blurb: Two companies, their stories and a few numbers. Work out the runway, see through the spin in a results release and decide what you would actually be buying.

activities.name: Beat the Index
activities.blurb: Draft five stocks and race them against the whole market for 20 years, then find out why most pickers lose and what fees quietly take.

activities.name: Crash Stories
activities.blurb: Make the call inside five real panics: tulips in 1637, the 1929 crash, the dot-com bust, 2008 and 2020.

activities.name: Headline or Hype?
activities.blurb: A morning on the markets desk. Sort real news from clickbait and paid promotion, and turn scary headlines into percentages.

activities.name: Investor's Seat
activities.blurb: Three founders pitch for your money. Ask the right questions, check whether customers are worth what they cost to win and catch the red flags.
